title: Davidsbündlertänze - No. 4
notable_excerpt: Key: B minor. Chord journey: v - i - III+6/4 - i - III4/2 - III7 - bVII7 - viio7 - i - i7 - bVI4 - iv - bVII4 - V7 - i6/4, closes i - v - v - i. Texture: driving chordal outbursts over a repeated bass.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #29785 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1887), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~98%, pitch ~85% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op6_davidsbuendlertaenze_4.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Davidsbündlertänze Op. 6.
